FACT_1.TITLE: Cats can't taste sugar
FACT_1.CONTENT: Which explains why your cheesecake goes untouched — not because your cat has self-control, but because evolution spared them from diabetes.

FACT_2.TITLE: Cats only meow at humans
FACT_2.CONTENT: It's not a sign of affection. It's their way of saying, "Dance, servant, dance."

FACT_3.TITLE: Cats purr to heal bones
FACT_3.CONTENT: Yes, their purrs can speed up healing. Basically, your cat is a furry chiropractor with zero medical license.

FACT_4.TITLE: Cats can fit through holes as small as their head
FACT_4.CONTENT: This isn't a magic trick. It's just physics mixed with chaos.

FACT_5.TITLE: Cats can run 30 mph
FACT_5.CONTENT: Impressive — until you realize they only use this Olympic-level speed to launch themselves across your bed at 3 a.m.

DISCLAIMER.TITLE: DISCLAIMER
DISCLAIMER.CONTENT_1: All content on Catire Time is for entertainment purposes only. This is a satire website.
DISCLAIMER.CONTENT_2: The articles on this site are satirical works based on real current events. While inspired by actual news, the stories presented are heavily fictionalized, exaggerated, and infused with humor, puns, and satire. They are not to be taken as factual news reports.
DISCLAIMER.CONTENT_3: Much of our content is generated with the assistance of artificial intelligence (AI), which combines real-world events with absurdity and humor.
DISCLAIMER.CONTENT_4: Names, characters, businesses, places, events, and incidents are either drawn from the original source, entirely fictional, or presented with satirical intent. Any resemblance to actual persons, living or dead, or actual events is purely coincidental and is not intended to be defamatory or malicious.
DISCLAIMER.CONTENT_5: Catire Time makes no representations or warranties of any kind, express or implied, about the completeness, accuracy, reliability, or suitability of any information on this site. Any reliance you place on such information is therefore strictly at your own risk.
DISCLAIMER.CONTENT_6: For accurate and up-to-date news, please consult reputable news organizations. Catire Time is not for factual information.

PRIVACY.TITLE: PRIVACY POLICY
PRIVACY.WHO_BODY: Catire Time is a satirical news site run by a small team based in Canada. If you have a question about this policy or about your data, email catirecontact@gmail.com.
PRIVACY.COLLECT_ACCOUNT: If you create an account, we store your email address and an encrypted version of your password. If you sign in with Google, we receive your email address from Google. We never see or store your Google password.
PRIVACY.COLLECT_ACTIVITY: While you are signed in, we record which articles you open and which ones you like, so we can show you your reading history and suggest articles you might enjoy.
PRIVACY.COLLECT_NEWSLETTER: If you subscribe to our newsletter, we store the email address you give us.
PRIVACY.COLLECT_VIEWS: We also count how many times each article is opened. That count is anonymous. It is not linked to you, your account, or your device.
PRIVACY.DEVICE_BODY: Some things never reach our servers at all. Your display name and biography are stored only in your own browser. So are your theme choice, your home page layout, your language, and whether you have seen the site tour. Clearing your browser data removes all of it.
PRIVACY.COOKIES_AUTH: When you sign in, we set cookies that keep you signed in. They are HttpOnly, which means scripts running in your browser cannot read them.
PRIVACY.COOKIES_ADS: We plan to show ads from Google AdSense. When we do, Google may set cookies to show ads and measure how they perform, and may personalise the ads you see. If you are in the United Kingdom or the European Economic Area, you will be asked for consent before that happens, and you can refuse. You can review and change Google's ad settings at any time at adssettings.google.com.
PRIVACY.SHARING_NO_SELL: We do not sell your data. We do not share it with anyone for their own marketing.
PRIVACY.SHARING_PROVIDERS: We use these services to run the site: Heroku for hosting, MongoDB Atlas for the database, and Google for sign-in and, in future, advertising. These providers process data on our behalf. Our servers and database are located in the United States, which means your data is stored outside Canada and may be subject to the laws of another country.
PRIVACY.RETENTION_BODY: We keep your account and its reading history for as long as your account exists. Newsletter email addresses are kept until you ask us to remove them. You can clear your reading history yourself at any time from your account page.
PRIVACY.CHOICES_HISTORY: You can clear your reading history from the account page whenever you like.
PRIVACY.CHOICES_REQUESTS: To see what we hold about you, correct it, unsubscribe from the newsletter, or delete your account entirely, email catirecontact@gmail.com. We will action your request within 30 days.
PRIVACY.CHILDREN_BODY: This site is not intended for children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their information. We never ask anyone's age, so we have no way to tell. If you believe a child has created an account or given us their email address, write to catirecontact@gmail.com and we will delete it.
PRIVACY.CHANGES_BODY: If we change this policy we will update the date at the top of this page. If the change is significant, we will say so on the site.

ABOUT.TITLE: ABOUT
ABOUT.INTRODUCTION: The only news organization on the internet founded, operated, and exclusively staffed by cats. You see, we got tired of watching our humans stare at their glowing rectangles, looking all stressed out about the news. It looked dreadfully boring. So we did what cats do best: we decided to help. We walked across the keyboards, sat on the routers, and eventually (through a series of tactical naps on warm laptops) accidentally created this news platform.
ABOUT.MISSION_CONTENT: Let's be transparent. We're not here to "inform the public" or "uphold democracy." We're here for one reason and one reason only: tuna. Our mission is to generate enough revenue to one day achieve The Dream: a life where we eat nothing but sashimi-grade, sustainably-fished, Pacific Bluefin Tuna. No more kibble. No more mysterious "fish-flavored" jelly. Just the good stuff. Every article you read, every ad you (please) click, brings us one step closer to that glorious, fish-filled paradise.
ABOUT.FUN_READS_CONTENT: The motivation for this app is to make reading news more engaging and give readers control over how they experience it. Let's be honest, a lot of news is too long, gloomy, or just plain boring. Our goal is to make it enjoyable, like taking plain broccoli and drenching it in flavorful gravy. We let readers choose exactly how deeply they want to engage. They can start with a catchy title, skim a quick summary, or dive into the full content. It's a 'three-speed' approach that matches how people naturally consume information today: quickly, selectively, and with ease.
ABOUT.DISCLAIMER_CONTENT: This is a satire site. All our articles are jokes based on real events. Please do not use us as a source for... well, anything, really. We are cats. We are not journalists.
ABOUT.GETTING_STARTED_CONTENT: New here, or want a reminder? The quick tour covers languages, themes, reading modes and arranging the home page.

WELCOME.TITLE: Welcome to Catire Time
WELCOME.BODY: Every article here is satire, a short and easy-to-read spin on real news, so take it all with a grain of salt. Click Next to see what the site can do.

PREFERENCES.TITLE: Set your preferences
PREFERENCES.BODY: Choose your preferred theme and language. You can change these anytime in the menu.

READING.TITLE: Choose how you read
READING.BODY: Keep scrolling for an endless feed, or switch to numbered pages. Your choice applies to the Mews feed and every category page, and you can change it any time from the section menu.

SECTIONS.TITLE: Arrange the home page
SECTIONS.BODY: Most sections (Mews, Popular, Editors, Cat Facts and the rest) can be collapsed or removed from their section menu. Changed your mind? Bring them back from that same menu.

BROWSE.TITLE: Find what you like
BROWSE.BODY: Browse by category along the top, follow a subcategory tag, or search. Search understands meaning as well as keywords, so you'll find related stories even when the words don't match.

ACCOUNT.TITLE: Make it personal
ACCOUNT.BODY: Create an account to like articles, keep a reading history, and get recommendations based on what you actually read.
